description: Principal measurement chain for the Joule-Thomson experiment. The PandID tag, sensor model, and calibration provenance for each sensor. Cernox calibration files are in data/cernox_calibration_data/SERIAL/. Polynomial-fit residuals quoted as DTrms come from the Lake Shore calibration certificates and are reproduced in calculate_jt_coefficients.CernoxCal.get_polynomial_fit_uncert.

sensors.role: inlet temperature (capillary upstream, on the T-piece)
sensors.sensor_only_expanded_uncertainty_k2_mK: approx 13 mK at 50 K rising to 28 mK at 180 K (Cernox sensor alone)

sensors.role: outlet temperature (capillary downstream, in a copper block in direct contact with the fluid)
sensors.sensor_only_expanded_uncertainty_k2_mK: approx 13 mK at 50 K rising to 28 mK at 180 K (Cernox sensor alone)
sensors.serial_number_note: Inferred from the calibration fit ranges: X93303 is the only sensor whose lowest-temperature fit covers 1.4 to 14.1 K, matching the CX-1050-SD-HT-1.4L spec.

sensors.calibration_note: Manufacturer factory calibration; not recalibrated in-house.
Manufacturer factory calibration; not recalibrated in-house.

sensors.role: binary mixture composition (system outlet, at atmospheric pressure)
sensors.type: binary gas analyser using speed-of-sound thermometry
sensors.calibration_note: Manufacturer factory calibration; constituent gases declared via the user manual.

context.acquisition_module: CABTR (Centrale d'Acquisition Basses Temperatures Rapide), built in-house at CEA/DSBT, interfaces TT101 and TT102 to the SCADA over Modbus.
context.transducer_transport: PT101, PT102, and GA016 expose RS-232 ports forwarded to the SCADA through Modbus gateways.
